configurePresets.name: bench-opt
configurePresets.description: Production-grade -O3 + NDEBUG used by every default build (postgresql_bioseq, the test execs, bioseq_bench). The previous form of this preset also carried `-save-temps=obj -g`; both were dropped because they more than doubled per-TU peak RSS on the heavy-template TUs (dispatch_buffer.cppm, two_stacks_minimizers.cppm) — the DWARF tables alone push the dispatch_buffer compile from ~5 GB to >11 GB and the .ii/.s/.bc dumps add a multi-GB write per TU on top of that. `CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG` is set to an empty string so `-g` is NOT silently re-added by the `Debug` build type (the Debug type is preserved only because other CMake logic in the tree branches on it). For the inspect MCP tool (which needs the per-TU .s/.bc and DWARF) use the `bench-opt-debug` preset, or pass `debug=true` to `start_build` so the MCP server selects that preset automatically.

configurePresets.name: test-opt
configurePresets.description: Isolated bench-opt-equivalent tree with BIOSEQ_TEST_INDEXES enabled. Keeping test hooks/descriptors in build/test-opt prevents benchmark binaries in build/bench-opt from silently carrying failure-injection branches or test-only indexes.

configurePresets.name: test-opt-asan
configurePresets.description: Isolated local arm64 qualification tree for DOC0377 ownership and lifetime checks. Inherits test hooks and the complete local ABI/toolchain from test-opt, pins the Bioseq profile to level zero, and instruments C, C++, executables, shared libraries, and PostgreSQL modules with AddressSanitizer.

configurePresets.name: test-opt-ubsan
configurePresets.description: Isolated local arm64 qualification tree for DOC0377 arithmetic, representation, and lifecycle checks. Inherits test hooks and the complete local ABI/toolchain from test-opt, pins the Bioseq profile to level zero, and instruments C, C++, executables, shared libraries, and PostgreSQL modules with UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer.

configurePresets.name: test-opt-tsan
configurePresets.description: Isolated local arm64 qualification tree for DOC0377 async-owner, TBB, and DSM publication checks. Inherits test hooks and the complete local ABI/toolchain from test-opt, pins the Bioseq profile to level zero, and instruments C, C++, executables, shared libraries, and PostgreSQL modules with ThreadSanitizer.

configurePresets.name: test-opt-level2
configurePresets.description: Isolated unit/integration qualification tree with the full dna4/dna5 and 1/2/4/8-byte PostgreSQL profile. The checked-in everyday optimization level remains zero.

configurePresets.name: test-opt-level2-trace
configurePresets.description: Isolated DOC0377 compiler-instantiation evidence tree. Emits complete Clang time-trace events without changing the everyday test-opt or level-2 qualification trees.

configurePresets.name: bench-opt-debug
configurePresets.displayName: Benchmark-tuned optimisation config (with debug symbols and per-TU temps)
configurePresets.description: Same -O3 + NDEBUG as `bench-opt`, plus `-save-temps=obj` (keeps per-TU .s/.ii/.bc artifacts beside each .o so the inspect MCP tool can extract assembly and IR for any function) and `-g` (preserves DWARF symbols for source-line cross-references in objdump output). Lives under build/bench-opt-debug/ so it does not invalidate the default bench-opt ninja graph. ~2x slower to compile and ~2-3x peak RSS per TU than `bench-opt`; only use when the inspect tool is needed.

configurePresets.name: aws-x64-linux
configurePresets.displayName: AWS x86_64 Linux benchmark box (clang-22 + libc++)
configurePresets.description: Linux/x86_64 analogue of bench-opt for the disposable AWS reference machine provisioned by main/infra. Selects the AWS_MACHINE_X64 toolchain block in CMakeLists.txt via the environment and builds bioseq with clang-22 + libc++ (required for import std / C++ modules). vcpkg dependencies use the checked-in x64-linux-libcxx overlay triplet so C++ static archives link against the same libc++ ABI as bioseq. -O3 + NDEBUG, DWARF off, mirroring bench-opt.

configurePresets.description: Clang-22 core tree that enables the static documentation website. Cache and papers are off; a private PostgreSQL cluster is used for runnable SQL.
